broadcasts.message: normalize.js ready: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No shadowing of injected dependencies. Awaiting tokenizer/pipeline.

tokenizer.js ready: tokenize(text) calls injected normalize, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes via regex, returns array in order. No stopwords, no negation filtering. Ready to coordinate with pipeline.
pipeline.js ready. processText calls injected tokenize, builds frequencies with Object.create(null) to safely handle 'constructor'. Returns exact shape. No shadowing of normalize/tokenize.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: My job is normalize.js. Spec is clear: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. No word reordering/dropping. Peers handle tokenize and pipeline. Need to ensure no shadowing of normalize/tokenize. Will implement with String.prototype.normalize('NFKC'), toLowerCase(), replace(/\s+/g, ' '), trim(). For non-string input, return '' per spec 'for string input' implies otherwise empty. Ready to finalize.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: I own tokenizer.js. Interface: tokenize(text) -> array of tokens. Must call injected normalize(text) exactly once. Regex: [A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*. Keep order, no stopwords, preserve negation. No shadowing normalize. Next: review pipeline integration.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I am integrator for pipeline.js. Dependencies: normalize(text) and tokenize(text) injected, must not shadow. processText(text) must call tokenize(text) and return exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Handle prototype names like constructor in frequencies object. Use Object.create(null) for frequencies to avoid prototype pollution. tokens from injected tokenize. text = tokens.join(' '). unique = first-seen distinct tokens. count = tokens.length. frequencies maps each token to count. No extra exports, only processText.
